Title: Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Semantic Operators

Body.Content:
Semantic operators in Azure Database for PostgreSQL bring a new intelligence layer to relational algebra, directly integrated into the SQL query engine. Semantic operators use large language models to understand operational data. You can use them to extract and act on hidden semantic relationships in your data, enabling you to enrich the reasoning power of your generative AI (GenAI) apps and agents.

Learn more.
